summary: Iter61 — FRONTEND ONLY bug fix verification: Add-Wave dialog on ProjectEstimator scrolls internally when AMS engagement type is selected (max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto added to DialogContent at ProjectEstimator.js L1713). Verified live on PRJ-0031 'S/4H implementation' /estimator at BOTH viewport sizes (1920x1080 desktop AND 1366x768 laptop): (1) Classes max-h-[90vh] + overflow-y-auto present on [role=dialog]. (2) Desktop AMS: dialog top=54 bottom=1026 height=972 inside vp=1080; maxHeight computed=972px; overflowY=auto; scrollHeight=1074 vs clientHeight=970 → isScrollable=true. (3) Laptop AMS: dialog top=38 bottom=729 height=691 inside vp=768; maxHeight computed=691.2px; scrollHeight=1074 vs clientHeight=689 → isScrollable=true. (4) Header 'Add New Wave' visible in viewport on both sizes (desktop y=79, laptop y=63). (5) Bottom 'Add Wave' submit button reachable by scrolling inside the dialog — confirmed visible in screenshots wave_ams_bottom_desktop.png and wave_ams_bottom_laptop.png. (6) Switching engagement back to Implementation hides AMS fields cleanly (ams-billing-frequency-input no longer in DOM) and Save still reachable. (7) Regression: data-testid=ams-contract-months-input, ams-billing-frequency-input, ams-billing-advance-input all render correctly when AMS_Shared selected.

issues: Note: The modal submit button is labeled 'Add Wave' (not 'Save'), and the only close affordance is the 'X' icon at the top-right (no explicit 'Cancel' text button). The user-attached screenshot description in the bug report referenced 'Save/Cancel' generically — the actual control set is 'Add Wave' + 'X close'. This is pre-existing copy, not a regression — flagged for awareness only.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectEstimator.js L1713: DialogContent className correctly changed to 'max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto'. Runtime confirms computed maxHeight = 90% of viewport.innerHeight on both 1920x1080 (=972px) and 1366x768 (=691.2px), and the natural content height (~1074px when AMS expanded) exceeds clientHeight → internal scroll engaged as designed. Header + submit button both reachable on laptop-class viewports.

Minor copy nit: The DialogDescription says 'Save and Cancel' is the implied action set, but the submit button text is 'Add Wave' and close is via X icon. Not introduced this iter; consider adding an explicit 'Cancel' button at the bottom for parity with most modal patterns — improves discoverability on touch/keyboard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — both viewports verified, all assertions met

rca of the issue: Root cause (iter60-reported by user): DialogContent had no max-height constraint, so when AMS engagement was selected (which conditionally renders 3 additional rows: Contract Length, Billing Frequency, Bill in Advance + 5 logistics rows), the dialog's natural height (~1074px) exceeded the laptop viewport (768px) AND was vertically centered via Radix Dialog's default top-50%/translate-y-(-50%) positioning, pushing both header (y≈-150) and footer (y≈924) outside the visible viewport. Fix at L1713: adding max-h-[90vh] caps the dialog at 90% of viewport innerHeight and overflow-y-auto enables internal scrolling. Verified empirically: computed maxHeight matches 0.9*vh on both viewports, dialog rect stays within [0, vh], and content beyond clientHeight is reachable via internal scroll. No regression to iter60 AMS billing frequency / bill-in-advance functionality.
